method: CPU from cumulative process values over client hold boundaries; memory trapezoidal time mean; then median of 3 runs per condition. RTT p99 is median of per-run p99, not a pooled percentile.
limitations: Single shared Windows host; baseline and candidate are measured on this host, not a production SLA.
Login/Heartbeat workload, no claim about whole-game content or maximum throughput.
Aggregation includes 1-second tail grace and larger bounded trace buffer; compare complete policy change, not one isolated CPU instruction.

plan.scope: Local Windows, same-host before/after; fresh runs, not reused earlier measurements
plan.policy: Old per-request metric+entry span vs normal Heartbeat aggregation; normal detail 1%, slow 100ms.
